rationale: The original thesis is fully intact after under a minute in the trade: price still holds the +1.6% gap and sits 0.8% above session VWAP ($33.49) with 11.2x relative volume, while SPY remains down 0.79% and VIXY up 2.72%, preserving the relative-strength divergence; with no new 1-minute bars, no new headlines, and price one cent from entry (invalidation at $33.66 still ~0.3% away), there is no new evidence to justify closing, and no mechanical case for a short flip against a stock still showing strength on a weak tape.
